scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run migrate up
scripts.db:migrate:down: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run migrate down 1
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run seed
scripts.db:seed:ci: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run seed -- --scale=0.1
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/psql.mjs reset && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:test: docker compose exec nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run test:e2e
scripts.db:test:naive: docker compose exec -T -e LIST_STRATEGY=naive nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run test:e2e
scripts.db:test:notiebreak: docker compose exec -T -e KEYSET_TIEBREAK=off nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run test:e2e
scripts.db:test:like: docker compose exec -T -e SEARCH_STRATEGY=like nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run test:e2e
scripts.check:tenancy: docker compose exec -T nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run check:tenancy
scripts.db:stats:on: docker compose exec -T nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run stats:on
scripts.db:stats: docker compose exec -T nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run stats
scripts.db:stats:reset: docker compose exec -T nest_server pnpm --filter=backend run stats:reset
scripts.trace:off: docker compose up -d nest_server next_app && docker compose --profile trace rm -sf otel_collector jaeger
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate --renew-anon-volumes && docker compose logs -f
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d && docker compose logs -f
